baseline.finding: Adoption drops the actual Button's3static sheets in every engine. Height changes36px to21/22/18px. Valid instances adopted before initial connection throw NotAllowedError when Lit applies a sheet created in another document.
baseline.control: An equivalent literal-style shadow control preserves measurements, isolating static stylesheet lifetime from token loading.

change: Use the owner's CSSStyleSheet constructor and cache per document/source through public APIs.
Apply finalized styles during root creation and adoption, including closed roots.
Use owned literal nodes without a browsing context; a stable comment preserves Lit's rendering boundary when those nodes are removed.
Preserve present unowned sheets and author nodes. Preserve same-document raw sheet identity; refresh foreign snapshots including media/disabled state.
Retain Lit's HTMLElement|DocumentFragment return contract and distinguish shadow roots by node type plus host. Honor owner-view nonce and native-shadow guard.
